title: [Bug]: Window Hopper: Alt + ` hotkey fails to trigger, but works fine in Command Palette
summary: Window Hopper Alt+` has a credible reproduction report, but the remaining work is maintainer-side: reproduce globally under the same locale/layout conditions and capture the raw key path.
next_action: Run the maintainer reproduction plan with zh-CN plus US layout and compare the global low-level-hook path with the in-window Command Palette path.

confidence.rationale: The report is detailed and narrowed to one hotkey, but the exact failing keyboard-path branch is still not proven from public evidence alone.

judgment.rationale: The issue already has enough detail to reproduce locally; the missing discriminator is in the maintainer-side keyboard event path, not in another reporter answer.
evidence: The report provides numbered steps and shows that Alt+` fails, Win+` succeeds, and Alt+` works inside Command Palette.
AltWindowCycle defines the default backtick key as VK_OEM_3 in src/modules/AltWindowCycle/dllmain.cpp.
The reporter already tested multiple input methods and a US keyboard layout, so the remaining work is to inspect the actual global key path under the same locale mix.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce under the reported locale/layout mix and log the raw global key sequence before committing to a code change.

fix_assessment.rationale: A repo-side fix is plausible, but the exact failing branch still needs a maintainer reproduction pass to distinguish key-code, modifier, and focused-window-path behavior.

issue_context.summary: The issue isolates a single discrepancy: the default Alt+` chord does not trigger Window Hopper globally, even though an alternate Win+` chord does and the same Alt+` chord works inside Command Palette.
known_information: The report is against preview build 0.101.2432 on Windows 11 25H2.
The reporter tested Microsoft Pinyin, WeChat Input Method, and a standard US keyboard layout.
A PowerToys diagnostic ZIP was attached.
inferences: The issue likely lives in the global hotkey path rather than in Window Hopper’s UI logic, because the functionality works when triggered by another path.
The discrepancy may depend on how the global hook sees Alt+OEM_3 under the reported locale/layout mix.
issue_context.analysis: The report is already specific enough for a maintainer to reproduce locally and inspect the key path. Another generic reporter request would add little value compared with a direct repro pass.
initial_investigation: AltWindowCycle is a new module introduced by PR #48281 and uses get_hotkeys() rather than GetHotkeyEx().
The module hardcodes the default backtick virtual key as VK_OEM_3 (0xC0) in src/modules/AltWindowCycle/dllmain.cpp.
The centralized low-level keyboard hook lives in src/runner/centralized_kb_hook.cpp and is the likely place to compare global behavior against the focused Command Palette path.

actions.label: Reproduce Alt+` global failure
actions.note: The remaining uncertainty is in the maintainer-side key path, not in missing reporter evidence.

reproduce.title: Compare Window Hopper Alt+` globally vs inside Command Palette
reproduce.version_requirement: PowerToys 0.101.2432 or newer with Window Hopper enabled
prerequisites: Windows 11 system with Window Hopper enabled
Ability to switch between zh-CN and US keyboard layouts or IMEs
setup: Configure Window Hopper to its default Alt+` hotkey.
Keep a second test pass available with Win+` as the control case.
steps: Press Alt+` globally and observe whether Window Hopper appears.
Change the hotkey to Win+` and verify that the feature triggers successfully.
Open Command Palette and test Alt+` there as a focused-window comparison path.
Repeat across the reported keyboard layouts / IMEs.
reproduce.expected_result: Window Hopper should trigger globally with Alt+` just as reliably as the control chord and the in-window Command Palette path.
